summary: Grass verge on rural Jesmond Road beside paddock; no homes close, but exposed through road.
reasons: Fast through road, nobody else parks

drivers.seclusion: Fenced paddock and trees behind; opposite are a tennis court, sheds (13-22 m, non-residential) and homes 30 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Mown grass verge a few metres wide beside the sealed lane; a van can pull fully off, though the fence line is close.
drivers.traffic: Marked two-lane through road with steady traffic; no cars seen parked along it.
drivers.convention: No parked cars, campervans or tents seen; no signs mapped.

flags: Through road with no parking convention
Low-lying creek ground at 200-260 m: min 4.8 m near Cubberla Creek
Steep first 200 m: up to 19% grade, narrow bush edge
Houses 7 m away at 105 m, 23-24 m at 18-52 m
sun_shade: Open to sun; tree shade from the east side in the morning around 400-450 m.

best_section.where: East verge opposite the tennis court and gravel yard, before the side-road junction
